description: This file defines a REST API endpoint class 'PayGradeAPI' within the OrangeHRM application, specifically for managing 'Pay Grade' entities. It provides CRUD operations including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting pay grades, and includes detailed API documentation annotations. The class utilizes traits and service layers for business logic and ensures validation of input parameters.

classes.name: PayGradeAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing Pay Grade entities, providing CRUD operations with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all pay grades, supports sorting and filtering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new pay grade entry.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific pay grade by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the details of an existing pay grade.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified pay grades by IDs.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Helper method to set the 'name' property on a PayGrade object and save it via the service layer.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request bodies, including ensuring the 'name' property is unique and within length constraints.
